description: This file defines the EasyHandle class, which represents a cURL easy handle within the Guzzle HTTP client library. It manages the handle resource, request and response data, headers processing, and error handling during HTTP transactions.

classes.name: EasyHandle
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a cURL easy handle, managing request/response lifecycle and headers.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Builds and attaches a Response object based on received headers, handling content encoding if necessary.
